```{r}
#| label: params
# Parameters ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN_DIR <- Sys.getenv("RUN_DIR", "experiments/runs/2026-11-09_bmv-unmix-compare-final")
REF_ARM <- "as188_joint" # reference arm (user, 2026-11-09)
ARM_LEVELS <- c("spectroflo", "as102_basic", "as102_var", "best102_neg", "best102_af", "as188_joint", "as188_fast_csv", "best188_p1", "best188_p5", "s102_c188", "s188_c102")
ARM_COLOURS <- c(spectroflo = "#E69F00", as102_basic = "#56B4E9", as102_var = "#009E73", best102_neg = "#00573F", best102_af = "#66C2A5", as188_joint = "#444444", as188_fast_csv = "#7A7A7A", best188_p1 = "#000000", best188_p5 = "#4B0082", s102_c188 = "#CC79A7", s188_c102 = "#D55E00", as188_reseed = "#BBBBBB")
MIN_NEG <- 200 # only for the sensitivity line below: fewest negatives per channel and sample
# the 2x2: spectra source x code version, variants on in all four cells (user, grill Q5, 2026-11-09)
CELLS_2X2 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~arm,          ~spectra, ~code,
  "as102_var",   "1.0.2",  "1.0.2",
  "s102_c188",   "1.0.2",  "1.8.8",
  "s188_c102",   "1.8.8",  "1.0.2",
  "as188_joint", "1.8.8",  "1.8.8"
)
# pinned cuts (user, grill Q21, 2026-11-09): a mindensity cut within PIN_TOL of the window edge in any arm means no valley
SET <- Sys.getenv("SET", "all") # "all" = every channel; "unpinned" = drop sample-channel cells with a pinned cut
CUT_WINDOW <- c(0, 3) # the window used by 02_metrics.R
PIN_TOL <- 0.02
NORMAL_TAIL <- pnorm(-3) # lower-tail fraction expected for a normal negative at median - 3 rSD
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
})
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 8))
rd <- \(f) read_csv(file.path(RUN_DIR, f), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(across(any_of("arm"), \(x) factor(x, levels = ARM_LEVELS)))
save_fig <- \(p, name, w = 180, h = 100) {
  if (SET != "all") name <- sub("\\.png$", paste0("_", SET, ".png"), name)
  ggsave(file.path(RUN_DIR, "figures", name), p, width = w, height = h, units = "mm", dpi = 150)
  p
}
pinned_cells <- read_csv(file.path(RUN_DIR, "mindensity_cuts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  summarise(pinned = any(cut < CUT_WINDOW[[1]] + PIN_TOL | cut > CUT_WINDOW[[2]] - PIN_TOL), .by = c(sample, channel)) |>
  filter(pinned)
# negative-based tables: with SET = "unpinned", drop rows whose channel(s) have a pinned cut in this sample
rd_neg <- \(f) {
  d <- rd(f)
  if (SET == "all") return(d)
  for (col in intersect(c("channel", "channel_a", "channel_b", "channel_i", "channel_j"), names(d))) {
    d <- anti_join(d, rename(pinned_cells, !!col := channel), by = c("sample", col))
  }
  d
}
# per-donor point plot: one point per donor, a bar for the median across donors
donor_points <- \(d, y, ylab, hline = NULL) {
  ggplot(d, aes(arm, .data[[y]], colour = arm)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sample), size = 2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
    {if (!is.null(hline)) geom_hline(yintercept = hline, linetype = "dashed")} +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ARM_COLOURS, guide = "none") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, shape = "donor sample")
}
```

Rendered with channel set: **`r SET`** (`all` keeps every channel; `unpinned` drops the sample-channel cells whose mindensity cut sits within 0.02 of the 0 to 3 window edge in any arm, user grill Q21).

## Negative spread (rank 1)

```{r}
#| label: f1-spread
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.5
ns <- rd_neg("negative_spread.csv")
ratio <- ns |>
  left_join(
    ns |> filter(arm == REF_ARM) |> select(sample, channel, rsd_ref = rsd_neg, n_ref = n_neg),
    by = join_by(sample, channel), relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  filter(arm != REF_ARM) |>
  mutate(log2_ratio = log2(rsd_neg / rsd_ref), sparse = pmin(n_neg, n_ref) < MIN_NEG)
by_donor <- ratio |> summarise(med_log2 = median(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(arm, sample))
by_donor_dense <- ratio |> filter(!sparse) |> summarise(med_log2_dense = median(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(arm, sample))
p_a <- donor_points(by_donor, "med_log2", "median over channels\nlog2(rSD arm / rSD as188_joint)", 0) +
  labs(title = "Per donor")
by_channel <- ratio |> summarise(med_log2 = median(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(arm, channel))
p_b <- ggplot(by_channel, aes(arm, med_log2, colour = arm)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ARM_COLOURS, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Per channel (median over donors)", x = NULL, y = "log2(rSD arm / rSD as188_joint)")
save_fig(plot_grid(p_a, p_b, nrow = 1), "f1_negative_spread.png", 190, 95)
```

```{r}
by_donor |> left_join(by_donor_dense, by = join_by(arm, sample), relationship = "one-to-one") |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable(caption = "Median log2 ratio per donor; right column drops channel/sample cells with fewer than MIN_NEG negatives in either arm")
```

## Spread matrix

```{r}
#| label: f2-matrix
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 4
sm <- rd_neg("spread_matrix.csv")
sm_mean <- sm |>
  summarise(ss = mean(ss, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(arm, marker_i, channel_j))
sm_diff <- sm_mean |>
  left_join(sm_mean |> filter(arm == REF_ARM) |> select(marker_i, channel_j, ss_ref = ss), by = join_by(marker_i, channel_j), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  filter(arm != REF_ARM) |>
  mutate(delta = ss - ss_ref)
lim <- quantile(abs(sm_diff$delta), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
p_m <- ggplot(sm_diff, aes(channel_j, marker_i, fill = pmax(pmin(delta, lim), -lim))) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(vars(arm), ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", name = "spread\nminus as188\n(donor mean)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) +
  labs(x = "target channel j", y = "source marker i")
save_fig(p_m, "f2_spread_matrix_delta.png", 190, 160)
sm |>
  summarise(median_ss = median(ss, na.rm = TRUE), p90_ss = quantile(ss, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), .by = arm) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Spread values over all marker pairs and donors")
```

## Shape of the negative populations (inside rank 3)

Ideal values: centring 0 (median / rSD), symmetry 0 (log2 of lower over upper half width; positive means a heavier negative side), roundness 1 (axis ratio of the standardised, winsorised negative cloud; a monotone function of the correlation, so it overlaps the leaning metric), and few strongly negative cells (below -3 x the as188 negative rSD, over all shared events).

```{r}
#| label: f10-shape
#| eval: !expr file.exists(file.path(RUN_DIR, "shape_negatives.csv"))
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
sh <- rd_neg("shape_negatives.csv") |>
  summarise(`abs centring (median / rSD)` = median(abs(centring), na.rm = TRUE), `abs symmetry (log2 half-width ratio)` = median(abs(symmetry_log2), na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(arm, sample))
ncell <- rd_neg("negative_cells.csv") |> summarise(`fraction below -3 x reference rSD` = median(frac_below), .by = c(arm, sample))
rnd <- rd_neg("roundness.csv") |> summarise(`roundness (axis ratio, 1 = round)` = median(axis_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(arm, sample))
shape_long <- sh |>
  left_join(ncell, by = join_by(arm, sample), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  left_join(rnd, by = join_by(arm, sample), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(arm, sample), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
p_shape <- ggplot(shape_long, aes(arm, value, colour = arm)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sample), size = 1.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(metric), scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ARM_COLOURS, guide = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, shape = "donor sample")
save_fig(p_shape, "f10_shape.png", 230, 170)
shape_long |> summarise(median = signif(median(value), 3), .by = c(arm, metric)) |> pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = median) |> knitr::kable(caption = "Median over 5 donors")
```

## Spectra effect and code effect (2x2)

Each value is (1.8.8) minus (1.0.2), averaged over the other factor, per donor. For spread and leaning, negative means 1.8.8 is lower; for stain index, positive means 1.8.8 is higher. The 1.0.2 code runs per-cell optimisation at 10 variants; the 1.8.8 code runs the joint pipeline, where `speed` has no effect (slow and fast outputs are byte-identical).

```{r}
#| label: f8-contrasts
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
cell_values_all <- bind_rows(
  by_donor |> transmute(arm, sample, readout = "spread (median log2 rSD ratio)", value = med_log2),
  tibble(arm = factor(REF_ARM, levels = ARM_LEVELS), sample = unique(by_donor$sample), readout = "spread (median log2 rSD ratio)", value = 0),
  si_donor |> transmute(arm, sample, readout = "stain index (median log2 SI ratio)", value = med),
  tibble(arm = factor(REF_ARM, levels = ARM_LEVELS), sample = unique(si_donor$sample), readout = "stain index (median log2 SI ratio)", value = 0),
  nc |> transmute(arm, sample, readout = "leaning (median abs rho)", value = med_abs_rho)
)
effects_for <- \(cells, design) {
  cell_values_all |>
    inner_join(cells, by = join_by(arm), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(sample, readout), names_from = c(spectra, code), values_from = value, names_sep = "_") |>
    mutate(
      `code effect (1.8.8 - 1.0.2)` = ((`1.0.2_1.8.8` - `1.0.2_1.0.2`) + (`1.8.8_1.8.8` - `1.8.8_1.0.2`)) / 2,
      `spectra effect (1.8.8 - 1.0.2)` = ((`1.8.8_1.0.2` - `1.0.2_1.0.2`) + (`1.8.8_1.8.8` - `1.0.2_1.8.8`)) / 2,
      design = design
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(c(`code effect (1.8.8 - 1.0.2)`, `spectra effect (1.8.8 - 1.0.2)`), names_to = "factor", values_to = "effect")
}
effects <- effects_for(CELLS_2X2, "as released (1.0.2 per-cell at 10 variants; 1.8.8 joint)")
p_fx <- ggplot(effects, aes(factor, effect, shape = sample)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(design ~ readout, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "effect", shape = "donor sample")
save_fig(p_fx, "f8_2x2_effects.png", 220, 95)
effects |> summarise(median_effect = round(median(effect), 3), donors_same_sign = sum(sign(effect) == sign(median(effect))), .by = c(design, readout, factor)) |> knitr::kable(caption = "Median over 5 donors and how many donors share the median's sign")
```

## Best-form steps (documented settings, user grill Q14 to Q16)

Each value is the later arm minus the earlier arm, per donor. For spread and leaning, negative is better; for stain index, positive is better.

```{r}
#| label: f9-best-steps
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.8
step_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~to,           ~from,            ~step,
  "best188_p1",  "as188_fast_csv", "1.8.8: AF refine on",
  "best188_p5",  "best188_p1",     "1.8.8: n.passes 1 to 5",
  "best102_neg", "as102_var",      "1.0.2: AF and variants refine on",
  "best102_af",  "best102_neg",    "1.0.2: AF clean up spectra"
)
step_fx <- step_pairs |>
  pmap(\(to, from, step) {
    cell_values_all |>
      filter(arm %in% c(to, from)) |>
      mutate(which = if_else(arm == to, "to", "from")) |>
      pivot_wider(id_cols = c(sample, readout), names_from = which, values_from = value) |>
      mutate(effect = to - from, step = step)
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(step = factor(step, levels = step_pairs$step))
p_steps <- ggplot(step_fx, aes(step, effect, shape = sample)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(readout), scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "later minus earlier arm", shape = "donor sample")
save_fig(p_steps, "f9_best_steps.png", 230, 100)
step_fx |> summarise(median_effect = round(median(effect), 3), donors_same_sign = sum(sign(effect) == sign(median(effect))), .by = c(readout, step)) |> knitr::kable(caption = "Effect of each documented setting")
```

## Decision table (priority order fixed before results: spread > stain index > artefacts incl. shape > agreement)

Every value was read from a figure opened on 2026-11-09. Values are medians over 5 donor samples from one batch of per-donor medians, **unpinned channel set** (88 of 160 sample-channel cells remain) (cells whose mindensity cut sits on the window edge are removed, user grill Q21). The all-channels spread figure was also opened and agrees in sign and ordering (`figures/f1_negative_spread.png`). No cutoffs are applied (ROADMAP:186).

Arms: **1.0.2 as released** = `as102_var`; **1.0.2 best** = `best102_neg` (AF and variants refine on, Matching Negative spectra); **1.8.8 as released** = `as188_joint` (its CSV-based rebuild `as188_fast_csv` matches it in spread); **1.8.8 best** = `best188_p5` (AF refine on, `n.passes` 5); **crossed** = `s188_c102` (1.8.8 spectra, 1.0.2 code).

| Rank | Readout (ideal) | SpectroFlo | 1.0.2 as released | 1.0.2 best | 1.8.8 as released | 1.8.8 best | Crossed | Figure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Negative spread, log2 vs 1.8.8 as released (lower) | +0.14 | -0.02 | -0.09 | 0 | +0.005 | -0.075 | `figures/f1_negative_spread_unpinned.png` |
| 2 | Stain index, log2 vs 1.8.8 as released (higher) | -0.17 | +0.145 | +0.13 | 0 | -0.04 | +0.30 | `figures/f4_stain_index_unpinned.png` |
| 3 | Leaning, median abs rho (lower) | 0.105 | 0.060 | 0.068 | 0.098 | 0.113 | 0.072 | `figures/f3_artefacts_unpinned.png` |
| 3 | Centring, abs median / rSD (0) | 0.51 | 0.315 | 0.41 | 0.60 | 0.585 | 0.395 | `figures/f10_shape_unpinned.png` |
| 3 | Symmetry, abs log2 half-width ratio (0) | 0.41 | 0.37 | 0.43 | 0.45 | 0.335 | 0.33 | `figures/f10_shape_unpinned.png` |
| 3 | Cells below -3 x reference rSD (lower) | 0.97% | 0.49% | 0.48% | 0.66% | 0.63% | 0.49% | `figures/f10_shape_unpinned.png` |
| 3 | Roundness, axis ratio (1) | 0.884 | 0.93 | 0.928 | 0.90 | 0.887 | 0.92 | `figures/f10_shape_unpinned.png` |
| 4 | ARI vs 1.8.8 as released | 0.40 | 0.37 | 0.50 | 1 (by definition) | 0.46 | 0.48 | `figures/f5_downstream.png` |

The lower-tail fraction is 3 to 7 times the normal expectation (SpectroFlo 7.2, 1.0.2 variants 3.7) with large donor scatter, and does not separate the arms (`figures/f3_artefacts_unpinned.png`).

## What the figures support

**1.8.8 against SpectroFlo (supported).** 1.8.8 as released has narrower negatives (SpectroFlo about 10% wider, 2^0.14) and a higher stain index (SpectroFlo about 12% lower, 2^-0.17), in all five donors for both readouts, and fewer strongly negative cells (0.66% against 0.97%, lower in all five donors). Leaning and roundness differ little and are mixed across donors. SpectroFlo is a little better on centring (0.51 against 0.60) and symmetry (0.41 against 0.45) (`figures/f1_negative_spread_unpinned.png`, `figures/f4_stain_index_unpinned.png`, `figures/f10_shape_unpinned.png`).

**1.8.8 against 1.0.2 (not exceeded on this dataset).**
- As released, 1.0.2 matches 1.8.8 on spread (-0.02, below zero in 4 of 5 donors, within noise) and is ahead on stain index (+0.145 log2, about 10%, in all five donors), leaning, negative cells and roundness (`figures/f1_negative_spread_unpinned.png`, `figures/f4_stain_index_unpinned.png`, `figures/f3_artefacts_unpinned.png`, `figures/f10_shape_unpinned.png`).
- In documented best form the ordering holds. 1.0.2 best is ahead of 1.8.8 best on spread (-0.09 against +0.002; below zero in 5 of 5 donors against a 3-2 split), stain index (+0.13 against -0.04, a 5 of 5 donor difference), centring, negative cells and roundness (0.928 against 0.887); 1.8.8 best is ahead only on symmetry (0.335 against 0.43).
- **Best settings, step by step** (`figures/f9_best_steps_unpinned.png`): in 1.8.8, turning the AF refine on (the package default, off in the original run) widens negatives, lowers the stain index and adds leaning in all five donors; `n.passes` 5 then narrows negatives slightly in all five donors and raises the stain index slightly. In 1.0.2, turning both refines on narrows negatives in all five donors; the stain index changes little and not consistently (median +0.014, range -0.03 to +0.06). The AF clean up spectra do not improve it (stain index mostly lower).
- **Spectra against code** (`figures/f8_2x2_effects_unpinned.png`): averaged over the two code versions, the 1.8.8 spectra raise the stain index (+0.11 to +0.24) and narrow negatives in all five donors (leg by leg, the 1.0.2-code leg is negative in one donor for stain index and one donor for spread; leg medians +0.066 and +0.149 for stain index); the 1.8.8 joint code lowers the stain index (about -0.27 log2) and widens negatives and leaning in all five donors, relative to the 1.0.2 per-cell code. The `speed` setting has no effect in the 1.8.8 joint pipeline (slow and fast outputs are byte-identical). The crossed arm (1.8.8 spectra with 1.0.2 code, a combination no one runs) is best on stain index (+0.30); on spread the 1.0.2 best-form arms are slightly lower (-0.088 and -0.081 against -0.074) with overlapping donor ranges.

**Readouts that cannot rank the arms.** Reseeding the 1.8.8 clustering (seeds 1, 2, 3 and 42, pairwise) gives ARI of median 0.51 (range 0.36 to 0.69); every arm's median ARI against 1.8.8 sits inside that range, and a few per-donor values (SpectroFlo 0.35, 1.0.2 variants 0.34, 1.0.2 AF clean up 0.31) fall below it (`figures/f5_downstream.png`). TNF and IL-2 positivity depends on where the cut lands (no valley in their densities, `figures/f7_cytokine_density_B11.png`) and is dropped; IFNg is 11 to 30% across arms.

## Limits

- Five donor samples from one batch of clean PBMC. The 1.8.8 documentation aims the joint pipeline, AF refine and extra passes at messier samples (tissue, tumour); none of that is tested here.
- **Best form** means the documented quality settings fixed before scoring (grill Q14), not tuned. SpectroFlo was compared as exported; its settings cannot be changed from here.
- **Pinned cuts:** 72 of 160 sample-channel cells (70 in the 6-arm run) have a mindensity cut on the window edge in some arm; they are excluded in the primary set and kept in the all-channels render (`report_all/report.html`).
- **Validation:** the 1.0.2 install reproduces the shipped files to within 0.002. The CSV-based 1.8.8 rebuild matches in every marker channel but differs in the AF channel in 15% of cells. An independent recomputation reproduced D1 spread and stain-index tables to 1e-15.
- **Reference arm:** as188_joint is the reference of every ratio; the two forms of 1.8.8 are not exact replicates of it.
